entries.label: zRAM state
entries.help: Enable or disable compressed swap in RAM. Changing this recreates the zRAM device, so open apps may stutter briefly.

entries.label: zRAM size
entries.help: How much RAM the compressed swap area may use. Too small can starve heavy multitasking.

entries.label: Compression algorithm
entries.help: Compression used by zRAM. lz4 is fastest, zstd compresses more at a higher CPU cost.

entries.label: admin_reserve_kbytes
entries.help: Memory kept free for the root user, so admins can still log in when RAM is full.

entries.label: block_dump
entries.help: Log every block read/write to the kernel log. A debugging aid; leave off normally.

entries.label: compact_unevictable_allowed
entries.help: Allow compaction to move memory pages that are pinned. Helps fight fragmentation.

entries.label: dirty_background_bytes
entries.help: Dirty data (bytes) at which the kernel starts writing back in the background.

entries.label: dirty_background_ratio
entries.help: Dirty data (percent of RAM) at which the kernel starts background writeback.

entries.label: dirty_bytes
entries.help: Dirty data (bytes) at which processes are forced to write back and stall.

entries.label: dirty_ratio
entries.help: Dirty data (percent of RAM) at which writes start blocking. Lower avoids long stalls.

entries.label: dirty_expire_centisecs
entries.help: How long dirty data may sit before it must be written back.

entries.label: dirty_writeback_centisecs
entries.help: How often the kernel wakes up to flush dirty data.

entries.label: swappiness
entries.help: How eagerly the kernel moves memory to swap. Higher frees RAM sooner but can add lag.

entries.label: vfs_cache_pressure
entries.help: How aggressively the kernel reclaims directory and inode caches.

entries.label: min_free_kbytes
entries.help: Free RAM the kernel keeps in reserve. Too low can cause allocation failures under load.

entries.label: extra_free_kbytes
entries.help: Extra RAM kept free beyond min_free_kbytes to speed up allocations.

entries.label: page_cluster
entries.help: Controls readahead clustering for swap. Rarely needs changing.

entries.label: overcommit_memory
entries.help: Policy for granting more virtual memory than RAM. 0 is heuristic and safe.

entries.label: Other vm tunables
entries.help: Every other writable virtual-memory setting the kernel exposes.
